motion.name: Motion
motion.hint: How much the Wings of Freedom sheets move: Full, Reduced (fades only), or Off. Your system's reduced-motion preference caps Full at Reduced. Only you see this.
motion.fullHint: Sheets settle, jolt, and flash; the gas and blade widgets animate.
motion.reducedHint: Short fades and colour only. Nothing slides or shakes.
motion.offHint: No movement. The gas and blade widgets are drawn still.
motion.menuHint: How much the sheets move. Only you see this.
motion.osReduced: Your system asks for reduced motion, so Full plays as Reduced.

gore.name: Gore
gore.hint: How wounds are drawn on the soldier figure: Low (clinical hatching), Standard, or Graphic. Only you see this.
gore.lowHint: Wounds as clinical hatching and dashed outlines. No blood.
gore.standardHint: Muted blood and cuts. No spatter or bone.
gore.graphicHint: Spatter, pooled blood, and bone; blood drips when Motion is Full.
gore.menuHint: How wounds show on the inked soldier and Titan. Only you see this.

stress.name: Auto-apply: Stress
stress.hint: Roll cards change Stress themselves: a Push, a Cover, a Stress Response, a Fear result, and a failed called roll staked on Stress. Off: the card lists the change with an Apply button.

wear.name: Auto-apply: gear wear
wear.hint: A Pushed roll’s Gear Dice showing 1 wear the gear item (a Blade Set is ruined), with any wear-ignoring Talent used. Off: the card lists the wear with an Apply button.

stressResponse.name: Auto-apply: Stress Responses
stressResponse.hint: A lasting Stress Response rolled on a card is recorded on the soldier. Off: the card lists it with an Apply button.

gas.name: Auto-apply: Gas Rating
gas.hint: A Gas Roll lowers the Gas Rating, and a Pushed ODM Gear roll marks the round’s Gas Roll as three dice. Off: the card lists the change with an Apply button.

fear.name: Auto-apply: Fear results and penalties
fear.hint: A Fear result’s next-roll penalty and forced move or strike are recorded, a used next-roll penalty is cleared, and a Drive shrug-off is marked. Off: the card lists them with an Apply button.
